title: Palazzo 30A | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Palazzo 30A is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Looking for a luxurious getaway in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach? Palazzo 30A is a stunning 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home designed to host up to 18 guests comfortably. Situated on the sought-after gulf side, this property is just steps away from the sparkling shores, making it the perfect destination for your next beach retreat. Enjoy the large main-floor deck, perfect for morning coffee or sunset gatherings while soaking in the coastal beauty. A complimentary six-seater golf cart is included with your stay, making it easy to explore the surrounding 30A communities, beaches, and local hotspots.Inside, the home offers a spacious open living area with direct deck access, plush sofas, and a large TV for cozy evenings. The dining area provides seating for eight, complemented by an adjacent eat-in kitchen with seating for two more. The fully equipped kitchen includes modern appliances such as a refrigerator with an ice maker, a coffee maker, and a microwave, ideal for preparing everything from snacks to gourmet meals.The layout of Palazzo 30A is thoughtfully designed across three levels. On the bottom floor, you’ll find a king bedroom and a comfortable living space with a couch. The middle level features two inviting bedrooms, one with two queen beds and the other with a king bed. The third floor is home to two queen beds and a luxurious master suite. The master suite is a retreat of its own, offering a king-size bed, a bunk room, and a loft with two single beds, perfect for families or larger groups.Step outside to your whirpool-style pool, complete with sun loungers for soaking up the Florida sunshine. It’s the ideal space for relaxing afternoons or lively gatherings.Palazzo 30A offers more than just a beautiful location; it gives you the chance to truly experience the best of 30A. Step out and explore local favorites like Greenway Station, Café 30A, Seagrove Market, Surfing Deer, and The Perfect Pig, each offering a taste of the area’s charm and character. Just minutes away, Seaside’s famous shops and dining spots, including Surfing Deer, invite you to soak in the vibrant coastal atmosphere. For a lively day out, visit The Big Chill, Old Florida Fishhouse, Seaside, and Watercolor, where you can enjoy dynamic dining and shopping that capture the spirit of 30A. With Palazzo 30A as your base, you’ll be perfectly positioned to enjoy all these unforgettable experiences.Whether you're planning a family getaway, a group trip, or a celebration, Palazzo 30A offers the perfect blend of comfort, luxury, and proximity to everything that makes Santa Rosa Beach unforgettable.Your stay at Palazzo 30A comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:*Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.*Enough Parking for 4 cars only.*Snowbird Friendly!A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
